import { applyKnownFileTransaction, recoverKnownFileTransaction, compileKnownFileTransactionPlan, type KnownFileTransactionPlanV1 } from "@agent-teams/repository-mutation";
import { readBoundedRegularFile, type PublishPreparedAbsentFileOptions, type BoundedRegularFileRead } from "@agent-teams/repository-mutation/node";
import type { AbsentFilePublicationOperations } from "@agent-teams/repository-mutation/qualification";
import type { CanonicalJsonValue, CanonicalJsonPrimitive } from "@agent-teams/repository-mutation/coordination";
import { canonicalJson, parseStrictJson } from "@agent-teams/repository-mutation/serialization";
import { portableRepositoryPathIdentity } from "@agent-teams/repository-mutation/paths";
import { assertKnownFileTransactionPlan } from "@agent-teams/repository-mutation/known-file";
// @ts-expect-error private composition dependencies must not become a consumer API
import type { KnownFileCoordination } from "@agent-teams/repository-mutation/node";
// @ts-expect-error qualification exposes exact mechanism seams, not the private coordination object
import type { KnownFileCoordination as QualificationCoordination } from "@agent-teams/repository-mutation/qualification";

declare const operations: AbsentFilePublicationOperations;
declare const prepared: PublishPreparedAbsentFileOptions;
// Check both assignability directions against the released reader function contract.
const releasedReader: typeof readBoundedRegularFile = operations.readBoundedRegularFile;
const projectedReader: AbsentFilePublicationOperations["readBoundedRegularFile"] = readBoundedRegularFile;
const releasedPreparedReader: typeof readBoundedRegularFile = prepared.readBoundedRegularFile;
const projectedPreparedReader: PublishPreparedAbsentFileOptions["readBoundedRegularFile"] = readBoundedRegularFile;
const releasedClassifier: typeof readBoundedRegularFile = prepared.classifyBoundedRegularFile;
const projectedClassifier: PublishPreparedAbsentFileOptions["classifyBoundedRegularFile"] = readBoundedRegularFile;
const custom: Partial<AbsentFilePublicationOperations> = { readBoundedRegularFile: async (path, limit) => readBoundedRegularFile(path, limit) };
const observed: Promise<BoundedRegularFileRead> = projectedReader("somewhere", 42);
// @ts-expect-error a non-file observation cannot satisfy this contract
const invalid: AbsentFilePublicationOperations["readBoundedRegularFile"] = async () => "not an observation";
const primitive: CanonicalJsonPrimitive = "text";
const value: CanonicalJsonValue = { example: [primitive, false, null, 1] };
const canonical: string = canonicalJson(value);
const parsed: unknown = parseStrictJson(canonical);
const path: string = portableRepositoryPathIdentity("managed/result.txt");
const plan: KnownFileTransactionPlanV1 = compileKnownFileTransactionPlan({ operations: [{ path, precondition: { state: "absent" }, postimage: { bytes: new Uint8Array() } }] });
assertKnownFileTransactionPlan(plan);
const applyResult = applyKnownFileTransaction({ consumerRoot: ".", plan });
const recoveryResult = recoverKnownFileTransaction({ consumerRoot: "." });
void [releasedReader, projectedReader, releasedPreparedReader, projectedPreparedReader, releasedClassifier, projectedClassifier, custom, observed, invalid, parsed, applyResult, recoveryResult];
